evolutionProposal.rationale: Add the event class, risk relation, and rules required by the newly observed behavior.

ruleDefinitions.name: sensitive_area_risk
ruleDefinitions.swrl: FishingVessel(?v) ^ hasState(?v, ?s) ^ LoiteringState(?s) ^ locatedIn(?v, ?a) ^ SensitiveArea(?a) -> hasPotentialIllegalActivity(?v, ?a)

ruleDefinitions.name: suspected_illegal_fishing_candidate
ruleDefinitions.plannerAction: materialize SuspectedIllegalFishingActivity using the deterministic event ID
ruleDefinitions.swrlPattern: hasPotentialIllegalActivity(?v, ?a) ^ hasState(?v, ?s) ^ durationSeconds(?s, ?d) ^ swrlb:greaterThan(?d, 600) ^ travelDistance(?s, ?m) ^ swrlb:lessThan(?m, 0.5)

ruleDefinitions.name: identity_conflict
ruleDefinitions.plannerAction: materialize identity conflict from declaration and inspection evidence

ruleDefinitions.name: communication_anomaly
ruleDefinitions.plannerAction: materialize anomaly from unanswered calls and encrypted message count in round window

ruleDefinitions.name: report_corroboration
ruleDefinitions.plannerAction: raise candidate confidence and threat level using report, loitering and sensitive area
